question: which of counting noise, a matched request's change between blocks, compilation seed, template and state-by-seed interaction carry the per-setting response scatter of the target-complement bank
authorization: none: the case waits for its written-case approval, which also covers its QRNG read

design.role: diagnostic, not a confirmation design: four seeds do not determine the tails of a seed distribution, and the result decides whether further compilation replication is warranted

resources.billing_rule: 1 credit per job plus 1e-6 per shot of the job's largest iteration max_shots
resources.timing_rule: 6.3 s plus 2.6e-05 s per sample for each iteration against the 300 s per-job limit; the written case restates credits and seconds from the live qd_platform.py plan output

qrng.service: ANU Quantum Numbers (aqn, keyed), scripts/anu_qrng.py draw
qrng.use: the first four values, which must be distinct, seed slots 0 to 3; value 4 + i orders block-1 instance i within its job, and a block-2 instance takes the order value of its block-1 match so matched pairs share a position

analysis.observation: one-click conditioned selected fraction of returned counts; every standard error is a reference value under independent Bernoulli trials, which the provider contract has not established
analysis.residuals: Delta_R and Delta_I per block, template and seed, each from one job; the beyond-margin rule reads these raw residuals
analysis.perf_ratio: per block, template and seed, r-hat = perf_g / (perf_f + perf_g) from that group's f and g iterations (result_fields.physical_perf, a provider field that moves with the sample budget and that DetectorBalancing rescales, so no qualified output acceptance); the readout reports r-hat, each superposition's deviation p(state) - r-hat and their RMS as an uninterpreted diagnostic that no branch reads
analysis.block_change: p(block 2) - p(block 1) per instance whose pair returned one circuit, split by class (the four superpositions; f; g, each its own class because their output efficiencies drift apart). calibration_shift reports each class's inverse-variance mean change with its z; block_change is the chi-square of the changes about their class means (heterogeneity), the statistic the stationarity branch reads. A common shift is a calibration shift, not stationarity
analysis.seed_dispersion: pooled chi-square of the four seeds about their inverse-variance mean per block, template and state: seed_basis over f and g, reported and read by no branch, and seed_superposition over the four superpositions, which the seed branches read; residual_seed does the same per block, template and residual family
analysis.seed_split: per block and template, a weighted two-way fit of the four superposition states by state and seed: the drop in chi-square from the state-only to the additive fit tests a common seed offset (3 df each), and the additive fit's residual chi-square tests state-by-seed interaction (9 df each)
analysis.template_effect: seed-mean outward minus reverse per block and state; reported, no branch reads it
analysis.aliasing: per block, seed slot and state, whether the outward and reverse returned circuits are hash-equal; per block, template and seed, how many distinct hashes the four superpositions returned; effective_compilations summarizes both. Reported, no branch reads it
analysis.support_conditioned: every test, reading and calibration shift rerun on selected clicks on the target support / one-click samples on the support, removing instance-specific dilution by unselected off-support modes (mode 5 holds 0.45 to 3.4 % of an iteration in the retained jobs); no branch reads it
analysis.position: per job, the Spearman correlation of the superposition deviation p(state) - r-hat with position in the job (the drawn order). Reported, no branch reads it
analysis.leak: every instance whose one-click samples fall outside the target support (modes with column weight above 1e-12) by more than 0.2 is listed in leak_outliers
analysis.tests: resolved at p < 0.01, consistent at p >= 0.05, inconclusive between
analysis.residual_margin: a residual exceeds the margin when |Delta| minus its simultaneous normal quantile at 0.01 over all 32 residuals times its reference error exceeds the margin

branches.recompiled: a matched pair returned different circuits: the blocks compare requests, the compiler's model changed, and the case reruns before any branch is read
branches.leak: an instance put more than 0.2 of its one-click samples outside the target support; read the failure before any other component
branches.stationarity: matched requests change between blocks beyond their class means: address stationarity and provider calibration before any fixed-effect confirmation
branches.seed-common: seeds shift the superposition states together: study seed selection on development data and validate a frozen selection on fresh data
branches.seed-interaction: seed effects differ between superposition states: a seed selection cannot transfer across states, so study the per-state compilation before any seed choice
branches.common-effect: seed dispersion is small but residuals persist beyond the margin: investigate preparation, filtering and processing, including unequal output acceptance, which only a qualified per-mode acceptance measurement can test; more seeds are not the remedy
branches.inconclusive: no component resolved and one test inconclusive, or a resolved common seed offset beside an inconclusive interaction test: more compilations or trials before a branch
branches.ensemble-candidate: seed effects small and residuals within the margin: an ensemble-defined certification case becomes a candidate once a common ensemble effect is supported

stop_conditions: a retained job body differs from the empty mitigation list, or a result is not an integer BSCount
a job fails, an iteration returns fewer samples than the frozen n, or the one-click eligibility rule excludes more than 0.01 of an iteration's samples
an iteration returns no compiled circuit or no positive result_fields.physical_perf
block 2 starts before both block-1 runs are collected and their readout integrity passes, or before the block gap elapses
--matched-check on b1-j2 and b2-j1, run after b2-j1 is collected and before b2-j2 is submitted, finds a returned-circuit hash that differs for a matched instance
a job of a block executes before the job that precedes it in the block, or a manifest differs from the frozen rebuild for its draw
a scheduled maintenance window overlaps the span from block 1's first execution to block 2's last; the pair then waits and reruns both blocks on one side of the window
spent credits or seconds reach the approved ceiling
